notes.title: v0.2.2.3 Early Access Patches and Updates
"Stalker" will participate the Shanghai's CP26 on July 25! ! !
notes.content:
[h3][b]NetBit @UW[/b]’s [b]"Stalker (Tailor)"[/b] will be exhibiting at the Shanghai CP26 on July 25th.[/h3]
[h3]♪ Zone: [b]Chinese AVG game zone[/b]♪
♪ Booth Number: [b]F80[/b]♪
♪ Booth name: [b]NetBit @UW[/b]♪
♪ Project Name: [b]Stalker[/b]♪[/h3]

⊳Due to the virus, the members of the production team failed to return to the China. Thus, our team's friends will participate instead of us.

⊳ We will participate Day 1 (July 25th). [b]Gifts[/b] will be provided at the booth.

[h3]Events![/h3]
⊳The producer's Weibo is carrying out the [b]Steam CDKey[/b] of "Stalker (follower)", drawing [b]20 people[/b] and sending [b]two CDKey[/b] to each person! For details, please see [url=https://m.weibo.cn/2469682832/4526441246865354][b][Transfer+Draw][/b]Draw 20 digits to send two CDKey on August 1st[/url] .

⊳Weibo of the [b]ACG Shouzhang[/b] also has a lottery. For details, please see [url=https://m.weibo.cn/5490407457/4527285811547728] [Transfer + draw] Follow and forward...[/url]
